warnings: This is a 5-year study (2012-2016) with year-to-year variation reported - need to extract overall means across years
Multiple protein hydrolysate types (Soy, Lup, Cas) at two concentrations each - extract each treatment vs control separately
Yield is reported in kg/vine, not standard kg/ha or t/ha units - may need conversion based on planting density (3300 vines/ha mentioned)
Tables show statistical letters (a,b,c,d) indicating Duncan's multiple range test results
Some data appears to have transcription errors (e.g., 'ea' in Table 2 control TSS value)
WARNING: LETTER-VAR - Variance shown as letters (a,b,c), not numbers
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: A bivariate analysis of variance (ANOVA) was performed with mean separation by Duncan's multiple range test
recon.control_definition: Water-treated vines served as a control
recon.treatment_definition: PHs (Soy, Lup, and Cas) were sprayed three times... at 1.6 and 6.4 g L−1 equivalents to 0.5 and 2.0 kg/ha, respectively
recon.sample_size_source: For each treatment 20 vines along the two rows were randomly selected, marked, and used in the assays
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract yield data from Table 1 only. Primary outcome is 'Yield (kg/vine)'. Extract each of the 6 treatments (Soy 1.6, Soy 6.4, Lup 1.6, Lup 6.4, Cas 1.6, Cas 6.4) separately against the Control. Data represents means across 5 years. Use Duncan's multiple range test letters as variance indicator. Note that n=20 vines per treatment. Planting density is 3300 vines/ha if unit conversion needed.
